headline: Barcelona host Clasico with 27 points but after first defeat
summary: Barcelona host Real Madrid at Camp Nou on Sunday with the lead in La Liga: 27 points, and they are 1st. But Barcelona lost 2-4 at Paris Saint-Germain on Tuesday, their first defeat this season, and Mundo Deportivo report Jules Kounde is doubtful with an ankle sprain. Reports say Vinicius Jr could miss the Clasico through a 3-match ban. Even so, the market makes Barcelona clear favourites at 59.4%, more than twice Real Madrid's 24.1%. The gap in goals has narrowed, from 1.19 to 1.02, and the market expects 4.18 goals, up from 4.03.
read: Barcelona host Real Madrid six points clear at the top of La Liga, days after a 2-4 defeat at PSG ended their unbeaten start and with Olmo injured and Kounde a doubt. The market still makes Barcelona clear favourites and rates them about a goal the better side, in a Clasico expected to produce around four goals, while Madrid may have to do it without the suspended Vinicius Jr.

facts.fact: Barcelona lead La Liga with 27 points from nine games, six points clear of Real Madrid in third.
facts.meaning: Barcelona arrive as leaders with a perfect recent league record, while Madrid need the win to close the gap at the top.

facts.fact: Vinicius Jr is currently set to miss El Clasico plus two more league fixtures, with Real Madrid pursuing provisional measures to have the ban reduced.
facts.meaning: Madrid could be without their main one-against-one threat on the left in the biggest game of their autumn.

facts.fact: Barcelona lost 2-4 at Paris Saint-Germain on Tuesday, ending an 11-match winning run and their unbeaten start to the season.
facts.meaning: Barcelona go into the Clasico off a first defeat, having conceded four for the first time this season.

facts.fact: Barcelona midfielder Dani Olmo was forced off injured in the first half against PSG and replaced by Fermin Lopez.
facts.meaning: Barcelona may have to reshuffle the creative middle of the team for the Clasico.

facts.fact: Mundo Deportivo reports Barcelona are increasingly pessimistic about Jules Kounde being fit for Sunday's Clasico because of a serious ankle sprain.
facts.meaning: Barcelona's first-choice right-sided defender is a doubt, which matters most against Madrid's left-sided attackers.

facts.fact: Barcelona are 59.4% favourites to win the Clasico, more than twice Real Madrid's 24.1%.
facts.meaning: The market makes Barcelona clear home favourites despite Tuesday's defeat in Paris.

facts.fact: The market's fair handicap has eased from Barcelona -1.19 to -1.02 in recent days.
The market's fair goal line has risen from 4.03 to 4.18 since the weekend.
facts.meaning: A high-scoring Clasico is expected — around four goals between them.
